edits.tsv.description: Ordered JSONL records converted to id,state,read,new_write,new_direction,new_target. IDs begin at zero; 346 edits affect 92 distinct transition rows.

program.description: New adaptive bounded search from fixed native start 74: choose a final action when an editable transition row is first encountered, exploring each allowed change and the keep-original branch, with a budget on distinct modified rows.
program.attribution: The candidate table, proposed rewrite alphabet, source-frame templates, full-support frame convention, and outward-ray idea are inherited from the attributed ProveIt PA194 research packets. The adaptive branching, future-edit-aware ray guard, and hash-triggered exact cycle replay are implemented in the new source.
program.relationship_to_prior_work: Extends the inherited fixed simultaneous-pair experiment to adaptive choices of up to K distinct rows, while fixing start 74. It does not assume the proposed rewrites are jointly runtime-neutral.
